headline: Kroger's identical sales slow to +1.0% and margins slip; Foran's first quarter shows costs outrunning sales.
guidance_note: Reaffirmed FY26 identical sales ex fuel 1.0-2.0% and adj EPS $5.10-5.30; Q2 identical sales expected roughly in line with Q1.
key_messages: Identical sales ex fuel +1.0% (vs +3.2%); revenue $46.1B beat but adj EPS $1.58 missed by a penny.
Gross margin 22.7% vs 23.0%: higher fuel mix, transportation costs and egg deflation.
Our Brands, eCommerce (+19%) and fresh drove sales; generic pharmacy shift and budget constraints were headwinds.
Foran is pacing 'surgical' price investments funded by supplier renegotiation and cost cuts.

consumer.pricing: Selective price cuts funded by sourcing savings; egg deflation weighed on sales.

macro_read: Grocery demand is decelerating as budget-constrained shoppers lean on private label; food inflation is too low to flatter sales.

sources.label: Chartmill: Kroger Q1 call focuses on cost, price and e-commerce
